verdict.rationale: Exporting all data in open formats is a fair question for a SaaS work-management tool, but the evidence pack never documents a Trello export feature (JSON, CSV, or otherwise). The REST API is only a developer building block from which an export could be constructed, and the 'Import data into Trello' Power-Up runs in the opposite direction, so neither earns credit. Community posts about lost accounts and users asking where to migrate do not show an export capability either.
